_meta.name: webhook
_meta.note: Webhook projection targets stay within the existing 12-value v1 WebhookEventType vocabulary for this P0 contract.

connection.event_received.note: A durable normalized provider receipt maps to the existing checkpoint vocabulary.

email.received.note: A durable inbound-mail receipt maps to the existing checkpoint vocabulary.

conversation.reply_received.note: A durable conversation reply maps to the existing checkpoint vocabulary.

memory.record_changed.note: Metadata-only memory mutation maps to a checkpoint.

storage.object_uploaded.note: Metadata-only resource upload maps to a checkpoint.

trigger.fire_requested.note: A durable asynchronous trigger handoff maps to the existing checkpoint vocabulary.

tool_event.note: Legacy tool_event maps to the existing tool execution webhook.

interrupt_request.note: Interrupt request creates a resumable checkpoint.

interrupt_required.note: Interrupt-required marker creates a resumable checkpoint.

assignment_received.note: Assignment receipt marks execution start for webhook consumers.

assignment_completed.note: Assignment completion maps to session completion.

model_tool_complete.note: Completed model tool call maps to tool execution.

heartbeat.note: Heartbeat remains in the closest existing operational webhook bucket.

update.note: Generic updates map to checkpoint creation.

progress_update.note: Progress updates map to checkpoint creation.

status_message.note: Status messages map to checkpoint creation.

status_message_chunk.note: Status chunks map to checkpoint creation.

final.note: Final event maps to session completion.

error.note: Error event maps to session failure.

system_tool_start.note: System tool start stays in the tool webhook bucket.

system_tool_chunk.note: System tool chunks stay in the tool webhook bucket.

system_tool_complete.note: System tool completion maps to tool execution.

system_tool_error.note: System tool error maps to tool failure.

hook_fired.note: Hook execution maps to checkpoint creation.

enrichment.note: Generic enrichment maps to checkpoint creation.

trigger.failed.note: Trigger failure maps to session failure.
